title: Git history: side-by-side diff window (slim JetBrains-style)
body:
Click a file in the Git History commit details pane -> reusable per-Project side-by-side Diff window (slim JetBrains-style).

Spec (approved): docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-diff-window-design.md
Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-23-diff-window.md (6 tasks; Task 1 = shared src/git_history/git.rs helper extraction, behavior-preserving)

Settled: no syntax highlighting, padded rows + straight connector gutter, prefix/suffix word highlight, no dropdowns, shared horizontal scroll, restore with target, git computes the diff with bounded -U200000 (INT_MAX corrupts output in git 2.39).
